Class Player

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.player.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Player extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a player in a game, identified by a unique ID and nickname, with associated game-specific objects like a rocket and a ship.
This class contains methods for manipulating and accessing the state of the player, including score-related properties, game objects, and player status.
Implements the Serializable interface to allow player data to be serialized.
